name: Adenine/purine riboswitch bound to 3AY (pyrimidine-2,4,6-triamine)
affinitySource: Gilbert SD et al. J Am Chem Soc 2006, 128:14214
notes: 1.7 Å adenine riboswitch (purine riboswitch aptamer domain). Ligand 3AY is pyrimidine-2,4,6-triamine, a tight-binding mimic of adenine. Literature/source notes describe base-stacking on U47/C74 and hydrogen bonds to U48/U51. In the current local PDBQT geometry, MacVina reports zero baseStacking contribution and zero expected-contact hit fraction, so the base-stacking annotation needs local atom-label and ring-plane review before this case is used for stacking calibration.

enrichmentSets.description: Adenine riboswitch actives (purine analogs) vs property-matched decoys
enrichmentSets.source: Literature actives + RDKit property-matched decoys (Tanimoto<0.35 vs actives)
enrichmentSets.intendedUse: active-vs-decoy enrichment calibration for aptamer scoring terms

affinityNotes: 3AY (pyrimidine-2,4,6-triamine) binds purine riboswitch; adenine Kd ~300 nM (Gilbert et al. 2006 JACS); 3AY analog Kd not directly published. 2,6-diaminopurine Kd ~10 nM same riboswitch.
